verdict.rationale: Browserbase's docs say agents can be deployed and run 'on a schedule or on demand.' That is a first-party recurring-schedule capability, not just a one-off run, so the core of the story is present. However, it rests on a single brief mention, with no detail on how schedules are set or whether exact run times can be specified. Missing for 10: documentation of schedule configuration (cron or specific-time syntax), how scheduled runs are managed and monitored, and independent or hands-on confirmation of scheduled scraping.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule scraping jobs to run automatically at specific times

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
